implementability_gates.C_epsilon_dot: NO; both U_x and X_e lack governed values

decision_basis: B6N2 fixes a post-event successor-model scope but preserves the source vector realization and exact topology/support.
The spherical radius, active vector action, edge tangent convention and plate_a-to-plate_b positive-opening convention permit deterministic local kinematic components.
Buck U_x is defined over a finite pure-shear zone; ARCANA has no authorized X_e, selected section support, endpoint/frame-transport rule, or positive physical forcing interval.
No B6N8-E sibling artifact was used as authority; its input interface is listed only for later integration.
